summary: Null-safe string comparison: reads two char** slots, substitutes the fixed fallback string at byte_5EA438 for either null pointer, and returns the strcmp result of the two resolved strings. Structurally a twin of the null-safe pointer dereference at 00415c30 (prelabel cluster_copy), consistent with callers that compare name/settings strings that may be unset.

operations.description: Dereference the right char** argument slot to obtain the right string pointer.
Guard on the right slot's string pointer being null.
Dereference the left char** argument slot to obtain the left string pointer.
Guard on the left slot's string pointer being null.
For a null right string, use the fallback default string at byte_5EA438 instead.
For a null left string, use the fallback default string at byte_5EA438 instead.
Return the strcmp result of the left resolved string against the right resolved string.
